summary: It proposes adding a catalogName method to the action and explores alternatives like querying FileIO for configuration, with tests covering various catalog scenarios. Equality deletes avoid conflicts because they do not alter data sequence numbers, whereas DVs are file‑scoped and can cause failures if a compaction rewrites the same file. The pull request proposes enabling aggregate pushdown for queries that GROUP BY identity partition columns in Spark. Currently Iceberg only pushes down aggregates for non‑GROUP BY queries, so this change would allow faster execution by using file metadata for grouped results.
